newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's industrial output falls 0.65 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's industrial output falls 0.65 pct in Jan.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 30 Reuter - Colombia's industrial output, excluding coffee processing, fell 0.65 percent in January compared with the same month a year ago, the National Statistics Department said Wednesday.
Taking into account coffee production, industrial output grw 0.92 percent, according to statement by the statistics department.
The sectors that showed the sharpest drops in output were, chemicals, beverages, rubber goods, textiles and non-metallic minerals.
Production of iron and steel, transport equipment, machinery, electrical goods and refined oil derivatives was up, the government department said.
